# Generated by "Claude files/tools/build_economy_probe.py". Re-run it instead of editing this file.

# Once a year for human countries (DA_Economy_Probe_on_actions.txt): a reading when the last is 25 years old.
DA_probe_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = DA_probe_on
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_global_flag = DA_probe_last }
				had_global_flag = { flag = DA_probe_last days = 9125 }
			}
		}
		DA_probe_run = yes
	}
}

# One reading: the fields, then a line per country that owns a province.
DA_probe_run = {
	clr_global_flag = DA_probe_last
	set_global_flag = DA_probe_last
	country_event = { id = DA_Probe.1 }	# the line naming the fields
	every_country = {
		limit = { num_of_cities = 1 }
		DA_probe_country = yes
	}
}
